name: Lala Reykis
source:
Lala is a fairy tailor who serves [url=/c167774]Freya[/url], because Freya's unstable height constantly tears her clothes. Honestly, [url=/c144566]I[/url] never thought I'd ever see a fairy in person. [url=/c144576]Orphea[/url] brought us closer, and I don't mind that at all. Although, from what I've gathered, her personality is rather unusual.
